name: Ikenie Reijou
source:
Main character is a popular student. He has an intense desire to humiliate, beat, insult and bully women. Together with bad friends he devises a plan to trap four school's most popular girls. This is the beginning of the Princess Slavery Project. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在学校里颇受欢迎，背地里却怀有羞辱、殴打、谩骂并欺凌女性的强烈施虐欲。他伙同一群损友精心设局，企图将校内最受瞩目的四位人气校花一网打尽——一场名为“千金奴隶化计划”的阴谋就此展开。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
